statement:
I, Utkarsh Pawar, submit this statement for case BAJ-2026-0001.

The incident occurred on 10 August 2026 at approximately 11:45 PM at the location identified as 123ert on NH‑48 near the Manesar toll plaza.

At that time I was riding my Suzuki FZ 125 bike (registration HR‑26‑DJ‑4521, colour black) travelling towards Gurugram. The front tyre suddenly burst, causing me to lose control of the motorcycle. The bike skidded across two lanes and struck the central divider before coming to rest in the fast lane. I was the sole rider and sustained no physical injuries, though I was shaken. I immediately activated the hazard lights and contacted the police from the scene. A toll attendant witnessed the event and assisted in moving the motorcycle to the side of the road. The motorcycle has incurred damage to the front bumper, left headlight and left‑side panels, and I have not altered the vehicle since the accident; the damage remains exactly as it occurred.

Observations / additional details: The correct vehicle registration is HR‑26‑DJ‑4521 and the vehicle involved is a Suzuki FZ 125 bike, not a Maruti Suzuki Swift. The incident date is confirmed as 10 August 2026 and the precise location is 123ert. The name of the toll attendant who witnessed the incident was not recorded. I did not inspect the burst tyre prior to the incident, nor did I report the tyre failure to any roadside assistance service beyond the police.

I confirm that the above statement is true to the best of my knowledge.
Utkarsh Pawar
13 August 2026
